paragraphs.text: Oyster is a creature type that represents a species of marine, bivalve mollusk with an irregularly shaped calicified shell, occurring on the bottom or adhering to rocks or other objects in shallow water. Some species of oyster produce pearls.
The only oyster printed is mono- blue . Consequently, oysters don't have a standard color in which they appear, though this may change in the future.
The creature type has only been used for Giant Oyster from Homelands . The card reappeared in the set Time Spiral as a Timeshifted card.
Oysters are seen to exist on Bloomburrow with Otterfolk collecting their pearls.
Ulgrotha is known to have giant underwater oysters.
